falsifier: If the exact finite-degree coefficient majorant still balanced Bellotti/KV decay only at U of order n^5 log^2 n, then R8's scale would not be attributable to the crude representation. R9 instead derives a sufficient n^(5/3) log^2 n scale.
scope: Diagnosis of why the R8 absolute-majorant discriminator was noninformative below its fixed-C n^5 scale; not a diagnosis of the true complement magnitude and not a cause of RH difficulty globally.
statement: The active R8 limitation was substantially representation-induced: exp(2 sqrt(nU)) ignores the fixed polynomial degree. An exact top-degree-relative coefficient bound reduces kernel log-growth to (n-1)log U-log((n-1)!)+n^2/U, moving the sufficient source-decay balance to U~n^(5/3)log^2 n.
